package.name: depth_anything_ros
package.description: Real-time monocular depth estimation node wrapping Depth-Anything-V2 (vendored under src/third_party). Subscribes to a sensor_msgs/Image color stream, runs the model on the GPU and republishes a 32FC1 depth image (relative depth, or true metres when a metric checkpoint is configured) plus an optional colorized bgr8 preview for RViz.
